newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume buoyant, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume buoyant, prices mixed.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange trade remained unseasonably buoyant, with 1,046 kg volume on Thursday compared to Wednesday's 990 kg, as banks engaged in arbitrage deals for the fourth consecutive day, dealers said.
Gold's dollar value eased further to $349.50 an ounce from $351.00 on Wednesday in line with the worldwide downward pressure on gold prices.
Lira values rose only slightly to 1,298,300 lira per gram versus the previous 1,298,000 as the lira remained unchanged against the dollar at 115,000 lira to the dollar.
"There was very little physical demand on the market due to the expectation of further price drops. Nearly all the trading was from banks conducting arbitrage deals," one dealer said.
Banks usually do arbitrage deals by buying gold in dollars and selling in lira to benefit from falling gold prices and a strong dollar.
Of the day's 1,046 kg of trade, 60.2 percent was in lira terms. The bulk was done in the morning with 726 kg.
